lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots extending from the posterior gill slit region to the caudal peduncle. The middle row displays the highest spatial density and largest blob diameters relative to dorsal and ventral adjacent rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Multiple near-vertical white bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows at approximately 90-degree angles, creating a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear ridges exhibit a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with the uppermost ridge most pronounced, separating the dorsal and lateral regions with light-exposed upper surfaces and shadowed lower surfaces.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the anterior margin and upper half of the first dorsal fin's visible lateral surface.
